constraints: No production source or postprocessor rules are edited. Raw word equality is not relocation or complete-object equality. Source-shape guards fail when the historical starting text changes; do not weaken them.

Pool candidates deliberately change frozen bodies in scratch copies only. full_pool_bytes_equal verifies the 668-byte 80346810..80346AAC span, not TU linkage. The emitted weak sqrt copy remains a linkage hypothesis; literalization also changes 16 target bodies. Never install a pool candidate without restoring all protected matches and passing a real full-link gate.
name: r61-enemy-probe
purpose: Reproducible scratch-only enemy address/peephole and constant-pool experiments, with mandatory full raw-object baseline fidelity and sibling accounting.
usage: AXIS is timer, optimizer_joint, lookup, first_use, carrier, allocation, address_tree, or pool. --only filters names; --show NAME prints an aligned diagnostic, optionally --entry or --pool-report. Results are generated under build/r61_enemy_probes.
